calls.statement:
SELECT s.store_key, s.store_id, s.store_name, s.city, s.region, s.valid_from, s.valid_to, s.is_current,
 (SELECT min(calendar_date)||' to '||max(calendar_date) FROM dim_date WHERE fiscal_year='FY2026/27' AND fiscal_period=5) AS p5_range,
 (SELECT count(*) FROM fact_sales_line f WHERE f.store_key=s.store_key AND f.sale_date BETWEEN DATE '2026-08-31' AND DATE '2026-09-27') AS lines_p5
FROM dim_store s WHERE s.store_id=102 OR s.store_name ILIKE '%Pitäjänmäki%' ORDER BY s.valid_from

calls.statement:
SELECT count(*) AS n_lines, count(DISTINCT sales_line_id) AS n_ids, count(DISTINCT (receipt_id, line_no)) AS n_receipt_lines,
 sum(quantity) AS units, count(DISTINCT etl_loaded_at) AS loads, min(sale_date) AS mind, max(sale_date) AS maxd,
 sum(CASE WHEN staff_purchase_flag THEN quantity ELSE 0 END) AS staff_units,
 sum(CASE WHEN quantity<=0 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS nonpos,
 (SELECT units_sold FROM (SELECT sum(units_sold) AS units_sold FROM rpt_daily_store_sales WHERE store_id=102 AND business_date BETWEEN DATE '2026-08-31' AND DATE '2026-09-27')) AS rpt_units
FROM fact_sales_line f WHERE f.store_key=4 AND f.sale_date BETWEEN DATE '2026-08-31' AND DATE '2026-09-27'

calls.statement:
SELECT cp.sku, cp.product_name, cp.category, cp.subcategory, sum(f.quantity) AS units_sold, count(*) AS n_lines, count(DISTINCT p.product_key) AS versions
FROM fact_sales_line f
JOIN dim_store s ON s.store_key = f.store_key
JOIN dim_product p ON p.product_key = f.product_key
JOIN dim_product cp ON cp.sku = p.sku AND cp.is_current
WHERE s.store_id = 102 AND f.sale_date BETWEEN DATE '2026-08-31' AND DATE '2026-09-27'
  AND cp.category <> 'ZZ Test' AND p.category <> 'ZZ Test'
GROUP BY ALL ORDER BY units_sold DESC, cp.sku LIMIT 8

calls.statement:
SELECT p.sku, sum(r.quantity_returned) AS units_returned, count(*) AS n
FROM fact_return_line r
JOIN dim_store s ON s.store_key = r.store_key
JOIN dim_product p ON p.product_key = r.product_key
WHERE s.store_id = 102 AND r.return_date BETWEEN DATE '2026-08-31' AND DATE '2026-09-27'
  AND p.sku IN (101624,101778,102244,102233,103670,102213)
GROUP BY p.sku ORDER BY p.sku
